release_notes.en-US:
Version 1.9 changelog:
- New: pick the OpenRouter model used for facts. Curated dropdown (free auto-router, Claude Haiku, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini Flash, Llama 3.3 70B free) plus a Custom slug option for power users. Lets you avoid hallucination-prone free models.
- New: configure fact categories. 11 preset checkboxes (Science, History, Space, Tech, Language, Food, Sports, Arts, Nature, Productivity, Geography) plus a free-text 'Also include' field for niche topics.
- New: anti-repetition ring. Recently-served facts are remembered (up to 200) so the same fact doesn't recur until the library has cycled.
